pain: The spec's concurrency, failed-commit, uncertain-commit and corruption scenarios must be proven against the Durable Object, not assumed from its single-threaded model.
who: HOME's trusted internal consumers: Collectors that append Activity Events and Projections that replay them.
done_when: Race tests send concurrent RPC calls through separately created stubs for the same object name, inside the Workers pool.
8 concurrent appends of one Event Key with different subjects give exactly one appended and seven conflict, over 20 rounds on fresh object names.
4 stubs making 200 distinct appends each in Promise.all give sequences 1 to 800 and verifyHistory passes.

A BEFORE INSERT trigger installed by the test through runInDurableObject makes the append throw EventLedgerStorageError with no receipt and an unchanged head; after the trigger is dropped the same append gets the next sequence.
An uncertain-commit test discards a successful receipt, calls abortAllDurableObjects, and the retry returns duplicate with that receipt.

With the append-only triggers dropped through runInDurableObject, edits to entry_json, sequence or previous_digest and deletion of the last row are each reported by verifyHistory (the truncation only with a trusted head); replay refusal is verified in ZER-21 after replay exists.
Thrown RPC errors are asserted with try/catch, no production code has a test-only fault hook, and npm run check passes.

out_of_scope: Live Collectors and Identity Binding config
Projections, Activity Calendar and Project Timeline
Any HOME API, route, MCP server or Scope enforcement
Real customer or account data; fixtures are synthetic
Cloudflare deploys, wrangler login and creating any Cloudflare resource
Merges and paid model spend without Danny's yes
